# Atlas (2024 film)
*Atlas* is a 2024 science fiction film released by Netflix, starring Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, a daughter of the creator of the AI terrorist Harlan Shepherd who leads a war of machines against humans in 2043. Set in 2071, the plot follows Atlas as she joins an International Coalition of Nations (ICN) mission to locate Harlan, who has escaped to a planet in the Andromeda Galaxy. After falling to the planet in a crashed ARC mecha and bonding with the ARC's AI, Smith, Atlas discovers that Harlan intends to use stolen carbon bombs to destroy Earth's atmosphere. Following Smith's capture by Harlan and subsequent reactivation through Atlas, the pair fight through AI forces to rescue the remaining survivors, ultimately defeating Harlan in hand-to-hand combat.
The film was written by Leo Sardarian and Aron Eli Coleite, with principal photography taking place in Los Angeles and New Zealand from August to November 2022. It received mixed-to-negative critical reception upon its release on May 24, 2024, scoring 19% on Rotten Tomatoes and 37 on Metacritic, with critics noting that while Jennifer Lopez delivered an impressive performance, the script struggled with intelligence and execution. Despite the critical backlash, the film was a massive streaming success, becoming the most watched title on Netflix in its first week with 60 million global views and maintaining a high viewer completion rate.
